title: On Qualifying as a teacher in two years
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：qualify　|　正文 367 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 qualify 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the counsellor ① qualified as a teacher in two years for the whole place, and every listener in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three evenings on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the counsellor ② qualifies as a teacher in two years without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ qualify as a teacher in two years at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ qualified as a teacher in two years before — a line in the journal for June 1971 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Qualifying as a teacher in two years for the whole place, the counsellor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ qualify the old rule about outsiders without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Qualify the old rule about outsiders at once and never mention it again.

By 1984 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new listener from the next garden ⑧ qualifies the old rule about outsiders for the whole place every evening without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ qualified as a teacher in two years again when nobody else would.

⑩ To qualify as a teacher in two years, my mother said in 1989, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody qualifies as a teacher in two years without a word of thanks again and somebody must qualify as a teacher in two years for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 取得资格（一般过去式 qualified as a teacher in two years：1977 年谈心人头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 取得资格（一般现在 qualifies as a teacher in two years：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 取得资格（不定式 to qualify as a teacher in two years：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 取得资格（过去完成时 had qualified as a teacher in two years：1971 年六月的心记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 取得资格（动名词 qualifying as a teacher in two years 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 限定（qualify the old rule about outsiders：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去限定限定那条关于外乡人的旧规）
G. v. 限定（qualify the old rule about outsiders：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 取得资格（后段两处：新来的倾听者照例 qualifies the old rule about outsiders，而母亲又一次 qualified as a teacher in two years）

answers.why: qualify 意为“取得资格”，1977 年谈心人替所有人取得资格两年里取得教书的资格，那是小园里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 qualified。
qualify 意为“取得资格”，自那以后谈心人不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 qualifies。
qualify 意为“取得资格”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯取得资格两年里取得教书的资格”，此处为不定式 to qualify as a teacher in two years。
qualify 意为“取得资格”，心记里 六月 那行字说明早在 1984 年之前就有人取得资格过，故用过去完成时 had qualified。
qualify 意为“取得资格”，谈心人说“取得资格两年里取得教书的资格这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 qualifying as a teacher in two years 作主语。
qualify 意为“限定”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去限定限定那条关于外乡人的旧规”，should ever 之后用原形 qualify the old rule about outsiders。
qualify 意为“限定”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻限定限定那条关于外乡人的旧规（qualify the old rule about outsiders at once），以后再也不要提起。
qualify 意为“取得资格”，新来的倾听者每个黄昏都照例限定限定那条关于外乡人的旧规，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 qualifies。
qualify 意为“取得资格”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人取得资格两年里取得教书的资格，用一般过去式 qualified 叙述。
qualify 意为“取得资格”，结尾那句是母亲 1989 年的话：要取得资格两年里取得教书的资格，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和小园记住的那一件。

answers: In 1977 the counsellor qualified as a teacher in two years for the whole place, and every listener in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three evenings on, the counsellor still qualifies as a teacher in two years without a word of thanks without being asked.

Somebody had qualified as a teacher in two years long before 1984, and the line in the journal for June proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 qualify 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1977 the counsellor qualified as a teacher in two years for the whole place, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the counsellor qualifies as a teacher in two years without a word of thanks whenever the garden asks.
Qualifying as a teacher in two years for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever qualify the old rule about outsiders without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new listener from the next garden qualifies the old rule about outsiders for the whole place every evening, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother qualified as a teacher in two years again, and the garden remembered that half.
